successors.note: Cliopatria's Kingdom of Dali shape for 947 overlaps 1097 of the 1182 cells of the Nanzhao shape of 900; the Dali Kingdom page has Duan Siping seize power in 937, ten years before Cliopatria's first Dali shape.

capitals.name: Yangjumie (Dali)
capitals.note: The pages are silent on a capital for 902-937; the Nanzhao infobox gives Yangjumie after 779 and the Dali Kingdom infobox gives Yangjumie, so it is carried across.

correction.text: the Nanzhao shape of 900 (Dali basin and Yunnan) held by the usurper states of 902-937

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for a period Cliopatria lacks: its Nanzhao row runs to 910 (the same 322,000 km2 shape from 866) and its Kingdom of Dali row begins in 947, leaving 911-946 empty. The Nanzhao shape of 900 is drawn for 902-937; the pages give no extent for the Great Changhe, Datianxing or Dayining, and the Dali Kingdom shape of 947 matches it closely (1097 shared cells).

ledger.note: 902: Zheng Maisi seizes the throne and founds the Great Changhe. 'The chief minister (buxie), Zheng Maisi, murdered the royal family and usurped the throne' and renamed the state Dachanghe (902-928).

928: Yang Ganzhen and Zhao Shanzheng overthrow the Zheng family and the state becomes the Great Tianxing (Datianxing). 'Yang Ganzhen helped Zhao Shanzheng overthrow the Zheng family and establish Datianxing (928-929)'; the Dali Kingdom page dates the change 927.

929: Yang Ganzhen kills Zhao and the state becomes the Great Yining (Dayining). 'Yang Ganzhen killed Zhao and created Dayining (929-937)'; the Dali Kingdom page gives 928-937 in one passage and 929-937 in another.

region.text: the Yunnan land of the Great Yining, Duan Siping's from 937

ledger.note: 937: Duan Siping takes power and founds the Dali Kingdom. 'Duan Siping seized power in 937, establishing himself at Dali'; infobox 'Established: 937'.

certainty.note: No page gives any frontier for these three regimes; the shape is Nanzhao's last.

notes: Written 2026-10-19 by the ea-04-b research agent as a direct successor of nanzhao that no Cliopatria row covers (the brief allows such counterparts), from the Nanzhao and Dali Kingdom pages only. One state with two renames, not three: the 928 and 929 coups keep the realm, the capital and the shape (rule 2); the Nanzhao page treats Great Changhe, Datianxing and Dayining as successive names. Dates differ by a year between the pages: Nanzhao page 902-928 / 928-929 / 929-937; Dali Kingdom page 903-927 / 927-928 / 928 or 929-937. Nothing opened says anything of the territory of these regimes, so the whole shape is the researcher's carrying forward of Cliopatria's 900 shape; a gap-filler should look for a page on the Dachanghe, Datianxing and Dayining. No ruler list is on the pages opened. Wikipedia title and Wikidata id are unknown (null). The Kingdom of Dali row (947-1259) belongs to another group; this dossier's successor link points to it.
